class.name: NNBlackboardSchema
class.brief_description: Typed key declarations and defaults that an [NNBlackboard] validates its writes against.
class.description:
Assign a schema to [member NNBlackboard.schema] to type-check every write to that board and to install defaults for absent keys. Each entry in [member keys] declares one key with its [member NNBlackboardKey.value_type]. Keys not listed are governed by [member allow_unknown_keys]. Writing [code]null[/code] is always accepted, because a [code]null[/code] value means the key is absent. A schema is only checked when it is attached. Changes made to it afterwards apply to later writes but do not re-check stored values or install new defaults; reassign the schema to do that. [codeblock] var health := NNBlackboardKey.new() health.key = "health" health.value_type = TYPE_INT health.has_default = true health.default_value = 100
var schema := NNBlackboardSchema.new() schema.allow_unknown_keys = false schema.keys.append(health) board.schema = schema [/codeblock]

method.name: accepts
method.description: Returns whether writing [param value] to [param key] is allowed. [code]null[/code] is always allowed. A declared key accepts values of its exact [member NNBlackboardKey.value_type], or any value when that is [constant TYPE_NIL]. An undeclared key is accepted only when [member allow_unknown_keys] is [code]true[/code].

method.name: get_defaults
method.description: Returns the default of every key with [member NNBlackboardKey.has_default] set, keyed by name. [Array] and [Dictionary] defaults are deep-copied.

method.name: get_validation_errors
method.description: Returns one message per problem: an empty entry in [member keys], an empty or duplicate key name, an out-of-range [member NNBlackboardKey.value_type], or a default that does not match its type. An empty result means the schema is valid. [NNBlackboard] refuses to attach a schema that has errors.

members.member: When [code]true[/code], keys not declared in [member keys] accept any value. When [code]false[/code], writing a non-null value to an undeclared key is rejected.
